name: productops
description: Product prioritization (RICE, WSJF, capacity scenarios) and Jira sprint health audits. Numbers are computed by local MCP servers; Claude explains them.

data_dir.title: Backlog folder
data_dir.description: Folder with your backlog CSV or JSON files. The prioritization server reads nothing outside it. Leave empty to use only the demo backlog.

jira_mode.title: Jira data source
jira_mode.description: fixtures = bundled demo team (no account needed); live = your Jira Cloud through the official Atlassian MCP server (run `npx -y @productops-mcp/jira@0.1.0 login` in a terminal first).
